lines.zh: 触手缓慢蠕动，绿光点点。
lines.en: Tentacles slowly crawl, green light twinkles.
Tentacles extend near the water's surface.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻划过，绿光微动。
lines.en: Tentacles gently stroke, green light moves.
My bell pulses and I drift forward.

lines.zh: 四根触手拖着，游得很慢。
lines.en: Four tentacles trail behind as I swim slowly.
I slip along the edge of the seagrass.

lines.zh: 顺着暖流往上浮了一格。
lines.en: I rise one block on the warm current.

lines.zh: 伞边碰到沙地，弹了回来。
lines.en: My bell touches sand and bounces back.

lines.zh: 在水里转了个透明的圈。
lines.en: I turn a clear circle in the water.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻摆动，绿光微弱。
触手轻轻摆动，微光闪烁。

lines.en: I drift like half a moonbeam.
Tentacles hang, waiting for the current.
My glow dims, then comes back.
Tentacles extend, focusing on the player.

lines.zh: 触手迅速移动，锁定玩家。
lines.en: Tentacles move quickly, locking on the player.
Tentacles wrap, wary of the player.
Tentacles tighten, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 触手缓缓移动，靠近玩家。
lines.en: Tentacles move slowly, approaching the player.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻触碰，观察玩家。
lines.en: Tentacles gently touch, observing the player.
Tentacles encircle, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 触手快速移动，警惕玩家。
lines.en: Tentacles move quickly, wary of the player.
Tentacles extend, locking on the player.
Tentacles encircle, focusing on the player.

lines.zh: 水母的伞盖被划开一道口。
lines.en: A cut opens across my jellyfish bell.

lines.zh: 发光触须诱惑你靠近，但别太靠近！
lines.en: Glowing tentacles tempt you close, but stay back!

lines.zh: 触手轻轻触碰，小心被吸引。
lines.en: Tentacles gently touch; beware the pull.

lines.zh: 触手闪烁，别让好奇心害你。
lines.en: Tentacles glow; let curiosity not lead you astray.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕，享受我带来的光明吧。
lines.en: Tentacles entangle; enjoy the light I bring.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻接触，享受我的柔软。
触须缠绕，感受我的温和。
触手轻轻接触，你将看到更多。
lines.en: Tentacles gently touch; more will be revealed.
Come closer, bask in my light.

lines.zh: 我体型庞大，勿触碰我触手。
lines.en: Be wary of my large tentacles.

lines.zh: 小心我的触手，它们很有力。
lines.en: Watch out for my strong tentacles.

lines.zh: 我触手挥动，小心被缠住。
触手猛然挥动，小心被拉近。
lines.en: Tentacles lash; beware of being pulled closer.

lines.zh: 我的触手挥动，小心被触碰。
lines.en: Watch out for my moving tentacles.

lines.zh: 触手迅速挥动，小心被抓住。
lines.en: Tentacles swiftly lash; beware of being grabbed.

lines.zh: 小心我的触手，它们很危险。
lines.en: Be cautious of my dangerous tentacles.

lines.zh: 我的触手挥动，小心被吸引。
触手突然挥动，小心被卷走。
lines.en: Tentacles lash suddenly; beware of being carried away.
Find a partner, emit light together.

lines.zh: 发光吸引同类，一起发光。
lines.en: Glow to attract a mate, shine together.

lines.zh: 寻找发光的同伴，共同发光。
lines.en: Find a glowing partner, shine together.

lines.zh: 释放光芒，寻找伴侣共同发光。
lines.en: Release light, seek a mate to shine with.

lines.zh: 同类发光，共同发出光芒。
释放光芒，寻找发光的伴侣。
lines.en: Release light, seek a glowing mate.

lines.zh: 发光吸引伴侣，共同发光。
lines.en: Glow to attract a mate, shine together.

lines.zh: 寻找发光的同类，共同发光。
lines.en: Seek a glowing mate, shine together.

lines.zh: 岸上我喘不过气，水里有吃的。
lines.en: I cannot breathe ashore, and the food is in the water.
I settle gently on your arm.
Only in water can I hold you.

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，我这团软胶只有四滴血。
lines.en: You are my prey, though this soft jelly has but four drops of life.
In the water I turn to face you first.

lines.zh: 一上岸我就扑腾，撑不久。
lines.en: On land I flop. I will not last.

lines.zh: 我的触须在水里铺成一张网。
lines.en: My tentacles spread into a net in the water.

lines.zh: 水面上的我，一上岸就喘。
lines.en: I drift on the water and gasp once beached.
I won't let you go easily.

lines.zh: 月光透进海面，我浮上来。
lines.en: Moonlight pierces the surface and I float up.

lines.zh: 我离了水，摔在沙上直扑腾。
lines.en: Out of water, I flop on the sand after the fall.

lines.zh: 魔法打穿了我的水母身。

lines.en: Out of water, I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我的光灭了半截。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea and half my glow went out.
